summary: Added a live Tasks page showing request progress, command approvals, execution results and replies.
instructions: Open Tasks in the navigation, or /tasks, then send a request in Chat. The page updates every second while visible. It shows Working, Awaiting approval, Finished or Interrupted alongside timestamped command/output/reply events. Follow Open chat to approve or deny commands; approvals still require your explicit action. Finished means the request ended, not that all commands or tests passed: inspect the output and final reply. The panel retains the last 10 requests and up to 100 events per request in the current runtime session; previews are limited to 8,000 characters per event and 1,000 for request text, with full messages in chat. It clears on restart and does not change saved chat history or the 50-message context window. All 148 automated tests, JavaScript syntax validation and startup self-test passed; no live model or visual browser test was performed.
